# Uzume

Source: https://github.com/eightman999/web/blob/2587b65dbbce3db1974e8b78a439ca088a5adcb8/uzume.js
Retrieved: 2026-10-18
Upstream SHA-256: `9676a373c3f86717687ef3ae1fd54558f1eae0553258f9108601e23151972cfd`

`uzume.mjs` preserves the supplied upstream source and appends ES module exports.
CELLWATCH-specific percussion synthesis, voice balancing, measure caching and stereo effects live in `../music-renderer.mjs`.
The supplied score is preserved in `../music/tactical-breach.txt` (176 BPM / D minor / 96 bars). No CDN or external audio service is used at runtime.

The game music “TACTICAL BREACH : OVERDRIVE” was created with ChatGPT 6 Pro and 6.1sol.
